champion.tips: MISS FORTUNE TIPS AND TRICKS Keep harassing the enemy in lane with your E as often as possible. But make sure you don’t run out mana trying to do so. Before channelling your Ultimate R , make sure you’re in a safe position and out of range of incoming CC or damage. A good time to use your Q on the minion wave is when the enemy is right behind a minion. The Q will bounce and deal a lot of damage to them.
champion.builds: THE BEST MISS FORTUNE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Miss Fortune Support build, you should take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Arcane Comet as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Cheap Shot and Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Blackfire Torch. For your last 3 items, you should build Liandry's Torment, Rylai's Crystal Scepter and finish with Morellonomicon. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - Q - W. Right now, this build has 40.6% winrate over 712 matches played. Optional Your second option for Miss Fortune Support build would be to take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are First Strike as your keystone, Cash Back, Biscuit Delivery and Jack Of All Trades in the primary tree, and Gathering Storm with Manaflow Band in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Blackfire Torch as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Liandry's Torment, Morellonomicon and Luden's Companion. The skill order for this build is E - Q - W. In the current patch, this build has a 39.3% win rate over 117 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Exhaust and Flash as your Summoner Spells, with runes being First Strike as your keystone, Cash Back, Biscuit Delivery and Jack Of All Trades in the primary tree, and Gathering Storm with Manaflow Band in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Bloodsong as your first item, then Boots of Swiftness as a second item and Umbral Glaive as a third item. You want to finish the build with Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night and Chempunk Chainsword. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 44.6% win rate across 74 matches played. Situational Miss Fortune Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Miss Fortune build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Miss Fortune runes page.
